text:
samira_cs: FYI - MeridianAI has a sudden drop in activity (~66% fewer active seats over 9 days). Their main champion left last Thurs. Procurement sent a shortlist mentioning RivalCloud. Potential renewal risk.

tom_csm: when's renewal? any billing flags?

samira_cs: renewal in 31 days. billing clean. CRM shows champion removed and new contact listed (Laura) but no reply yet.

leo_eng: any infra regressions? latency/5xx/429?

samira_cs: no errors. big drop in embedding jobs and webhook consumers.

renewals-bot: renewal-30d alert for account meridianai sent to @ana_rev and @tom_csm.

ana_rev: looping in renewals 94 if procurement is shortlisting RivalCloud we should prepare a retention offer: 6-week trial with usage credits + Optimize quickscan. need committed tier vs current usage.

tom_csm: playbook: 1) 48h personalized outreach + small credit 2) tech healthcall with Leo 3) ROI + pilot doc from Ana. agree? :thinking_face:

samira_cs: +1. Also request top-10 endpoints, last-30d seat churn, and any moved cron jobs. I'll log asks in CRM.

leo_eng: i can pull token/endpoint breakdown and a short quantization demo. need ~48h to gather traces.

ana_rev: i'll draft a pilot one-pager and competitor-cost comparison. if they ask for formal RFP pricing, escalate to sales-engineering.

tom_csm: i'll schedule outreach tomorrow afternoon and lead the contact. Samira, update CRM and tag meridian as "at-risk - renewal window".

samira_cs: done. outreach scheduled. Laura auto-replied OOO but open next week. will update after call. :white_check_mark:
